def controls_B4(b4_run, run_id):
 import sys,time,json,collections
 sys.path.insert(0,'results/T-048/scripts')
 from chay import OUT,read,dump,sha
 from kiem import read_run,doi_chieu_khoa
 from cham import WORLDS
 from m1_danh_gia.pha2 import giai_ma_json
 folder=OUT/'runs'/run_id;folder.mkdir();start=time.monotonic();deadline=start+10800;b4=OUT/'runs'/b4_run
 (folder/'command.json').write_text(dump(dict(B4=b4_run,analysis_source=ANALYSIS_SOURCE,selection='Mọi cặp root/đối thủ không đổi quan hệ trong cùng tầng, thỏa max E4 hòa với PV rA=1 hoặc cạnh tranh max PV/đếm'))+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 while not (b4/'kiem.json').exists():
  if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Control chờ B4 tới trần')
  time.sleep(10)
 meta=read(b4/'kiem.json');assert meta['closed'];assert sha(b4/'ban-ghi.jsonl')==meta['phase2_sha256'];records=[giai_ma_json(json.loads(x)) for x in (b4/'ban-ghi.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()];assert len(records)==meta['totals']['cases'];cached_child=None;counts=collections.Counter()
 with (folder/'trung-gian.jsonl').open('x',encoding='utf-8') as output:
  for case in records:
   child=case['source_child']
   if child!=cached_child:
    _,_,p=read_run(OUT/'runs'/child);batch={r['config_id']:(r,d) for r,d in p()};_,_,rp=read_run(OUT/'runs'/case['reference_child']);r0,d0=next(rp());batch[r0['config_id']]=(r0,d0);cached_child=child
   base=case['base'];eid='R0-E4-S1-e0.05-a0.01' if base=='R0' else 'E1+E2-E4-S1';er,ed=batch[eid];zr,zd=batch[base+'-z-S1'];root=case['root']
   for i,w in enumerate(WORLDS):
    rank,zrank=ed['trace']['xep'][i],zd['trace']['xep'][i];pv=zd['trace']['phan_vi'];assert ed['trace']['phan_vi'].keys()==pv.keys();assert all(ed['trace']['phan_vi'][u]['mau_sha256']==pv[u]['mau_sha256'] and ed['trace']['phan_vi'][u]['e4']==pv[u]['e4'] for u in pv);um=ed['trace']['don_vi_the_gioi'][i]['m'];zm=zd['trace']['don_vi_the_gioi'][i]['m']
    def positions(r):return {e:n for n,b in enumerate(r['ket_qua']['blocks']) for g in b['groups'] for e in g}
    before,after=positions(rank),positions(zrank)
    if root not in before or root not in after:continue
    rows={k['ma']:k for k in rank['kenh']};zrows={k['ma']:k for k in zrank['kenh']};a=doi_chieu_khoa(rank,root,um);za=doi_chieu_khoa(zrank,root,zm)
    for rival in sorted(before.keys()&after.keys()-{root}):
     rb=(before[root]>before[rival])-(before[root]<before[rival]);ra=(after[root]>after[rival])-(after[root]<after[rival])
     if rb!=ra:continue
     b=doi_chieu_khoa(rank,rival,um);zb=doi_chieu_khoa(zrank,rival,zm)
     if a['tier']!=b['tier'] or a['tier'] not in (1,2):continue
     def types(keys,raw):return {k:raw[k]['don_vi'] in pv for k in keys}
     am,bm,zam,zbm=(types(k['max_channels'],raw) for k,raw in ((a,rows),(b,rows),(za,zrows),(zb,zrows)))
     saturated=[k for k in a['max_channels']+b['max_channels'] if rows[k]['don_vi'] in pv and pv[rows[k]['don_vi']]['oracle'][rows[k]['huong']]['r_A_one']]
     tied=a['rendered_key'][1]==b['rendered_key'][1]
     cross=bool(any(zam.values()) and any(not x for x in zbm.values()) or any(zbm.values()) and any(not x for x in zam.values()))
     if not (tied and saturated or cross):continue
     first=next((n for n,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a['rendered_key'][1:],b['rendered_key'][1:])) if x!=y),None)
     facts={}
     for key in set(a['max_channels']+b['max_channels']+za['max_channels']+zb['max_channels']):
      raw=rows[key];u=raw['don_vi'];direction=raw['huong'];facts[key]=dict(unit=u,kind='PV' if u in pv else 'count',E4_s=raw['s'],z_s=zrows[key]['s'],m=um.get(u))
      if u in pv:facts[key].update(r_A=pv[u]['oracle'][direction]['r_A'],r_N=pv[u]['oracle'][direction]['r_N'],c=pv[u]['z']['c'],IQR=pv[u]['z']['IQR'],sample_sha256=pv[u]['mau_sha256'])
     rr=case['mechanism']['worlds'][w]['RR'];row=dict(opaque_id=case['opaque_id'],dataset=case['dataset'],cell=case['cell'],base=base,world=w,root=root,rival=rival,relation=rb,RR_E4=rr['E4_S1'],RR_z=rr['z_S1'],both_correct_top1=rr['E4_S1']==rr['z_S1']==1,E4_max_tied=tied,saturated_E4_max_channels=saturated,first_key_before=first,cross_type_max_competition=cross,root_E4=a,rival_E4=b,root_z=za,rival_z=zb,channels=facts,source_child=child,reference_child=case['reference_child'])
     output.write(dump(row)+'\n');counts.update(pairs=1,correct_pairs=row['both_correct_top1'])
 (folder/'kiem.json').write_text(dump(dict(closed=True,counts=counts,B4_sha256=sha(b4/'ban-ghi.jsonl'),controls_sha256=sha(folder/'trung-gian.jsonl'),wall_seconds_including_wait=time.monotonic()-start))+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 return dict(counts)
